t: In front of you is a statue of Michael Faraday. Faraday was an English chemist and physicist who, with very little formal education, taught himself his way into becoming one of the most influential scientists in history. His research on the magnetic field around a conductor carrying a current led him to the idea of the electromagnetic field. He also showed that magnetism can affect rays of light, and he discovered the principles behind electromagnetic induction and electrolysis. That is why he is honoured here in bronze.
